function.name: check_availability
function.description: Checks whether a specific appointment date and time slot is available in the City Dental Clinic booking calendar.

date.description: The desired appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-09-15').

time.description: The desired appointment time in HH:MM or 12-hour format (e.g. '14:00' or '2:00 PM').

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Books a confirmed dental appointment for a patient and records it into the clinic booking database and Google Sheets.

name.description: The full name of the patient (e.g. 'John Doe').

date.description: The appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-09-15').

time.description: The appointment time in HH:MM or 12-hour format (e.g. '14:00' or '2:00 PM').

reason.description: The reason for the appointment or service requested (e.g. 'Routine Checkup', 'Teeth Cleaning', 'Toothache Consultation').
